sections.description: WooCommerce abilities for MCP. Product/taxonomy/customer/coupon CRUD plus a generic wc/v3 REST request for the rest of the store.
sections.changelog:
2.9.0

  • Adds the brand base to get-permalink-settings and update-permalink-settings — the fourth field on the Permalinks screen, missed in 2.8.0. WooCommerce keeps it in its own woocommerce_brand_permalink option rather than with the other bases, so reading the usual option does not reveal it.
  • Reported both as stored and as the slug the URLs actually use, since an empty value falls back to brand. Refused on stores where the product_brand taxonomy is not registered.

2.8.0

  • Two new abilities, get-permalink-settings and update-permalink-settings, for WooCommerce's product URL base -- the Settings > Permalinks > Product permalinks setting. It was reachable from nowhere before: the wc/v3 settings API does not expose it in any group.
  • Supports the same choices the screen offers (default, shop base, shop base with category, custom) plus the category, tag and attribute bases, takes the shop base from the shop page's own slug so a renamed or nested shop page works, sets use_verbose_page_rules the way WooCommerce does, and rebuilds the rewrite rules -- without which the setting changes and every new product URL returns 404.
  • Requires confirm: true, since every product URL on the site changes.

2.7.2

  • Security audit: toggle-payment-gateway now requires confirm: true — disabling a payment gateway can block checkout for customers relying on it, and the annotation (destructive:false) undersold that impact.

2.7.1

  • CRITICAL: fixed a data-corruption bug — create/update-product-category, create/update-product-tag, coupon descriptions and create-customer were not wp_slash()-ing content before writing, causing WordPress's own unslash step to strip literal backslashes. WooCommerce's own CRUD objects were found to be inconsistent: orders (HPOS), existing-customer updates and product variations were verified already safe and left untouched, while category/tag creation, coupon descriptions and new-customer creation needed the fix.

2.7.0

  • Initial public release: 30 abilities covering product category/tag/variation CRUD, customer and coupon CRUD, order creation/refund, payment gateway listing/toggling, product image/taxonomy assignment, and a generic wc/v3 REST passthrough.
